palette_documentation.label: Ratio Fine
palette_documentation.description: Moves the modulator ratio from an octave down through unison to an octave up.

palette_documentation.label: Drive
palette_documentation.description: Increases oscillator and filter drive from clean to saturated.

palette_documentation.label: Size Spread
palette_documentation.description: Widens the distribution of grain sizes around the stock midpoint.

palette_documentation.label: Excite Size
palette_documentation.description: Lengthens the excitation from a short strike toward a scrape.

palette_documentation.label: Diffusion
palette_documentation.description: Adds diffusion from a dry particle stream to a dense cloud.

palette_documentation.label: Filter Pos
palette_documentation.description: Offsets the filter response from low-pass toward high-pass around the HARMONICS setting.

palette_documentation.label: Ensemble
palette_documentation.description: Moves ensemble depth from dry through the stock setting to fully wet.

palette_documentation.label: Register
palette_documentation.description: Selects stepped register and inversion presets around the stock center step.

palette_documentation.label: Punch
palette_documentation.description: Changes pitch-envelope punch from restrained to exaggerated.

palette_documentation.label: Mode Spread
palette_documentation.description: Spreads the shell modes from compact to strongly inharmonic.

palette_documentation.label: Y Offset
palette_documentation.description: Offsets the Y-axis path to reveal complementary terrain contours.
